dog.description_text:
💕 BONNIE
🐶 Female | Approximately 4 months old | 19.4 lbs.

How anyone could dump this precious girl and simply drive away, we'll never understand. 💔

Bonnie was found wandering through a Lowe's when a homeless person nearby told her rescuer that they had witnessed someone let this little puppy out of their car and drive away.

Just like that, Bonnie was left behind.

But here's the amazing thing about dogs…

Despite what someone did to her, Bonnie absolutely LOVES people. ❤️
dog.name: BONNIE
